text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Satono! Your present 
issss... Me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Look, I really thought hard about it, 
okay? But I figured you already have so 
many things, Satono—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I was thinking I could give 
you my time! Everywhere Satono wants to 
go, everything you want to do, I'll tag 
along for all of it♡

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a wonderful suggestion! I'm so 
glad♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well then—ah! There are a few places I'd 
like to visit.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Inside the recently built high-rise 
tower, in an all-glass lounge—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A jewelry shop that's super popular right 
now, and a famous, long-established 
watchmaker!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they'll prepare a VIP room either 
way, so let's just relax and enjoy 
ourselves♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Whaaaaaat...!? That's so high-class! I 
totally want to go, I want to go!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, doesn't this kinda feel like *I'm* 
the one getting a present...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? Even if that's the case, 
I don't mind one bit♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Being able to enjoy it together makes me 
happier than anything else!
